description: **A decide/ branch can rewrite the question it answers**: `decide_answer_problems` in `warscape/policy.py` does not compare the row with its base, so the answering commit may change `question` and `options`. Refuse any change beyond the answer fields. Also in this area: `newest_by_finding` in `warscape/proposals.py` breaks a same-date tie on the random id (read, not run; it fails closed in `check`), and `max_questions` is in no doc. Depends on W45 merging. From W45 review round 1, 2026-11-06.
title: A decide/ branch can rewrite the question it answers
